resolved.title: 字符串函数
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]String Functions[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

String have many useful functions:
[b]count(str) [/b]returns how many times the [b]str[/b] substring appears in the given string. 
[b]upper[/b]() converts the string to uppercase.
[b]lower[/b]() converts the string to lowercase. 
[b]replace(old, new)[/b] replaces all occurrences of [b]old[/b] with [b]new[/b].  
[b]len(str)[/b] returns the length of the string (number of characters).

Take a look at this code for examples:[code format="py" codeId="3119"]x = "This is some text"

print(x.[b]count[/b]("s"))
print(x.[b]upper[/b]())
print(x.[b]lower[/b]())
print(x.[b]replace[/b]("some text", "awesome"))
print([b]len[/b](x)) [/code]
[note]Note, that these functions return a new string with the corresponding manipulation.[/note]

content.text:
字符串有很多有用的函数：

- **count(str)**: 返回**str**子串在给定字符串中出现的次数。
- **upper()**: 将字符串转换为大写字母。
- **lower()**: 将字符串转换为小写字母。
- **replace(old, new)**: 将所有出现的 **old** 替换为**new**。  
- **len(str)**: 返回字符串的长度（字符数）。

resolved.title: 字符串查找及替换
resolved.problem_statement_md:
你正在编写一个文本编辑器，需要实现查找/替换功能。
代码中定义了字符串`text`。输入两个字符串，分别代表要查找的子串和要在文本中替换的内容。

你的程序需要输出替换的数量，以及新的文本。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Manipulating Strings[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are making a text editor and need to implement find/replace functionality.
The code declares a [b]text[/b] string. You need to take two string inputs, which represent the substring to find and what to replace it with in the text.
Your program needs to output the number of replacements made, along with the new text.

For example, for the given text "I weigh 80 kilograms. He weighs 65 kilograms.":

[b]Sample Input[/b]
kilograms
kg

[b]Sample Output[/b]
2[b] [/b]
I weigh 80 kg. He weighs 65 kg.
 
The program replaced 2 occurrences of the word [b]kilograms[/b] with [b]kg[/b].
[note]Note, that you need to output the number of replacements, before the replaced text.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 你需要在替换后的文本之前输出替换的数量。

code_templates.template:
# 请勿修改text
text = "Amy has 128 dollars, while David has 54 dollars. Amy is going to the zoo. David watches soccer."
code_templates.solution_code:
text = "Amy has 128 dollars, while David has 54 dollars. Amy is going to the zoo. David watches soccer." 
a=input()
b=input()

print(text.count(a))
print(text.replace(a,b))
